definitions.frame_core_outside_point_fraction: fraction of input points outside at least one frame-core axis
definitions.domain_clipped_point_fraction: fraction of points strictly outside a quantization-domain bound and therefore saturated to an edge code
definitions.domain_saturated_point_fraction: fraction of points with at least one coordinate at or beyond a bound; exactly the quantizer's low/high saturation branches
definitions.boundary_code_coordinate_fraction: fraction of axis coordinates encoded as code 0 or max; includes ordinary edge-bin points and is not itself a clipping rate
definitions.duplicate_*_point_fraction: fraction of input points belonging to a non-singleton quantized-tuple or curve-key group
definitions.miad_delta_from_D0: current MIAD minus D0 MIAD for the same algorithm/rule/geometry/seed
